parole.significato: Used to form female given names, especially from male given names and, less commonly, from other female given names.
parole.testo: Borrowed from Danish -ine (“female name-forming suffix”). The Danish name-forming pattern was introduced from France through Germany and ultimately continues Latin -īna (“feminine form of -īnus”), the feminine of -īnus (“of or pertaining to”).
